rows.proof: `Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education / Office of School Finance / FY18 Chapter 70 / Regional District Enrollment and Contributions by Member City or Town / 832 Montachusett`, PDF page 144 of the FY2017 annual town report. THIS IS A STATE DOCUMENT REPRODUCED IN THE TOWN REPORT -- the publisher is DESE, not Lunenburg and not Monty Tech -- and the page still carries the `Return to Index` link and the LEA dropdown from the web page it was printed off. THE PAGE IS A PHOTOGRAPH (pdfplumber returns 1 word; one image at 228 dpi) so it was rendered and READ. THE PRINTED HEADER, column by column, with its two spanning group headings: `LEA | Member` then under `District Foundation Enrollment`: `FY17 | FY18 | Change | Pct of Town Enrollment`, then under `District Required Minimum Contribution`: `FY17 | FY18 | Change`. 18 member towns under a `District Total` row printed ABOVE them, not below. FIVE OF THE SIX COLUMN TOTALS CLOSE EXACTLY -- FY17 enrollment 1,500 and all three Required Minimum Contribution columns, 9,077,316 / 9,194,861 / 117,545 -- and 36 of 36 row Change identities close exactly (FY18 minus FY17, in both enrollment and contribution), the District Total row included. CROSS-CHECKED: all 18 `District Required Minimum Contribution FY18` figures are, to the dollar, the `(1) REQUIRED MINIMUM CONTRIBUTION` column of page 148's COMMUNITY ASSESSMENTS table, and their total 9,194,861 is page 141's `(1) FY 18 REQUIRED MINIMUM CONTRIBUTION`. Three pages, three publishers' renderings, read on two different instruments, agreeing exactly.

THE FY18 FOUNDATION ENROLLMENT COLUMN DOES NOT FOOT, BY ONE STUDENT, AND THE TOWN REPORT PRINTS TWO DIFFERENT FIGURES FOR THE SAME QUANTITY. What the data shows: this page's 18 FY18 enrollments sum to 1,495 against its own printed District Total of 1,496, and the Change column sums to -5 against a printed -4; the detail rows are internally consistent at 1,495, because all 18 row identities (FY18 - FY17 = Change) close, and the District Total row's own identity closes too (1,496 - 1,500 = -4). So the one-student gap is between the detail and the total, not inside either. WHERE IT IS: page 148 of the same report, the district's COMMUNITY ASSESSMENTS table, prints a FOUNDATION ENROLLMENT per town that agrees with this page for 17 of the 18 towns and disagrees for HARVARD -- 8 there against 7 here -- and page 148's column foots to 1,496 exactly. WHAT THIS DOES NOT SHOW: which figure is right. This page states Harvard at 6 in FY17 with a Change of +1, so its 7 is internally consistent; three different single corrections would each close this page (the 7, the +1, or the District Total), and neither document says which is the error. Nothing here tests it. -- closes: DESE's own FY18 Chapter 70 regional enrollment file for LEA 832, which is published at doe.mass.edu and is the source both pages are copying.
The page prints a Change column for enrollment and all 18 rows satisfy it exactly.
The page prints a Change column for the required minimum contribution and all 18 rows satisfy it exactly.

rows.proof: `COMMUNITY ASSESSMENTS / FISCAL YEAR 2018`, PDF page 148 of the FY2017 annual town report -- the Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School District's FY2018 assessment on each of its 18 member towns. A STATE/REGIONAL DOCUMENT REPRODUCED IN THE TOWN REPORT: the publisher is Monty Tech. THE PAGE IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 1 word and the page holds one image at 326 dpi -- so it was rendered and READ, not recognised. THE PRINTED HEADER, read off the render column by column: `COMMUNITIES | FOUNDATION ENROLLMENT | FOUNDATION BUDGET | (1) REQUIRED MINIMUM CONTRIBUTION | (2) TRANSPORT/ OPERATING ASSESS. | (3) CAPITAL ASSESS. | (4) BONDS | APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY'2018 | APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY2017 | CHANGE FY'17 ~ FY'18`, with a banner `FISCAL YEAR 2018` spanning columns 3 to 7 and a final row labelled `Total`. 18 towns. FIVE INDEPENDENT PROOFS. (1) Nine printed column totals on the `Total` row, every one of which the 18 town rows reproduce within the declared tolerance -- FOUNDATION ENROLLMENT, (1) REQUIRED MINIMUM CONTRIBUTION, (4) BONDS and APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY'2018 tie EXACTLY and the other five miss by 1 or 2. (2) The row identity the numbered headings state, (1)+(2)+(3)+(4) = APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY'2018: 12 of 18 towns close exactly and the other six by $1, and the Total row closes exactly (9,194,861 + 678,665 + 187,500 + 253,050 = 10,314,076). (3) The second row identity, APPROVED FY'2018 - APPROVED FY2017 = CHANGE, closes on 18 of 18 towns AND on the Total row, exactly, with no rounding slack at all. (4) Page 141 of the same report prints four of this page's column totals independently, as the numbered components of the FY2018 budget: `(1) FY 18 REQUIRED MINIMUM CONTRIBUTION $9,194,861`, `(2) NET TRANSPORTATION & OTHER OPERATING $678,665`, `(3) NET CAPITAL ASSESSMENT $187,500`, `(4) NET BONDS $256,456/$253,050` and `TOTAL ASSESSMENT (All Budgets) $10,314,076` -- and its `Net School Spending 23,339,672` is this page's FOUNDATION BUDGET total. (5) Page 149, ASSESSMENT HISTORY, prints both assessment columns per town; all 38 figures agree with this reading EXACTLY, and page 149 is read off a TEXT LAYER while this page is read by eye off a photograph, so the two readings share no instrument. EVERY MONEY FIGURE IS A WHOLE-DOLLAR DISPLAY OF AN AMOUNT CARRYING CENTS, so a printed total is the rounded TRUE sum rather than the sum of the rounded parts, and a sum of n such displays can miss by up to n/2 dollars. The declared tolerance is $9, which is that bound for the widest sum here (18 addends); the largest residual observed is $2. WHAT ESTABLISHES ROUNDING RATHER THAN A MISREAD is FOUNDATION ENROLLMENT: it is a COUNT, carries no cents, and its 18 values tie to the printed 1,496 EXACTLY while every money column beside it misses by 1 or 2 -- and the CHANGE identity, which is a difference of two displays rather than a sum, closes on all 19 rows with nothing to spare.
